cohort: The study included 2193 pregnancies in 2110 women, aged >=18 years, who were diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) between 2018 and 2022.
finding: Patients with GDM and baseline BMI in the obese range experienced the highest rate of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, while those with overweight BMI had similar outcomes to individuals who had normal BMI at baseline.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were significantly higher in the obese BMI category (40.9%) compared to overweight (28.5%) and normal (26.9%) BMI categories among women with GDM.
birth_weight: Around 3.3-3.5 kg (mean birthweights: normal BMI 3.3 kg, overweight BMI 3.4 kg, obese BMI 3.5 kg)
